TRACEABLE FINDINGS

Evidence register

Every statement separates OEM existence, exact physical location, and visibility in the seller gallery.

OPTIONS, PURPOSE AND BUDGET

Clean-out modes

Planning costs are AUD unless shown otherwise. Hire and parts are vendor prices; labour is explicitly an engineering allowance, not a quotation.

Recommended sequence: establish a dealer-verified baseline, restore damaged OEM access, run a documented trial clean, then select the routine or identity-preserved mode by crop risk. No external transfer circuit is proposed.

NO-SERIAL BASELINE

Field verification checklist

Use during dealer inspection or when the machine arrives. Do not operate or remove guards solely to complete this sheet.

Isolation first: park safely, lower attachments, stop the engine, remove the key and isolate stored energy. Use the serial-matched operator's manual before opening any access. Never enter a grain tank or work near moving components.

DOCUMENT CONTROL

Sources and links

Links open the manufacturer, manual host, Australian guidance or current supplier page used for the finding.

Engineering limitations

This is concept-level evidence and budget planning, not an operating instruction, installed quotation or certification of zero carryover. Lock-out, guarding, access-at-height and dust/fire controls must follow the serial-matched Case IH manual, site procedures and applicable law. Parts must be confirmed by machine PIN and serial break.
